name: slack-update
description: Draft a team status update for a channel from your personal profile and the records you select. Draft only: it reads nothing from Slack and posts nothing.

placeholders.description: Name of your new skill, lowercase words joined by hyphens. It cannot use the reserved kit prefix or match a bundled skill.
One-line description that tells an agent when to use the skill. Letters, digits, spaces and basic punctuation only.
placeholders.default: Use when the user wants a draft status update for their team channel from their profile and the records they select. Draft only.

placeholders.description: The scope the updates usually belong to. It must be the workspace scope.
Who reads the channel: the scope or a team inside it, such as the scope followed by a dot and a team name.
